description: This file defines enums, constants, and functions related to guardrail providers, including legacy, dynamic, and map-based provider management, along with logic for rendering configuration settings and logo assets.

methods.name: populateGuardrailProviders
methods.description: Populates dynamic guardrail providers from API response, maintains backward compatibility with legacy providers.

methods.name: getGuardrailProviders
methods.description: Retrieves current guardrail providers, prioritizing dynamically loaded providers if available.

methods.name: populateGuardrailProviderMap
methods.description: Populates the main provider map with dynamic providers based on API response.

methods.name: shouldRenderPIIConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines if PII configuration settings should be rendered for a given provider, specifically for Presidio PII.

methods.name: shouldRenderAzureTextModerationConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines if Azure Text Moderation configuration settings should be rendered for a given provider.

methods.name: shouldRenderContentFilterConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines if Content Filter configuration settings should be rendered for a given provider.

methods.name: getGuardrailLogoAndName
methods.description: Returns the logo URL and display name for a given guardrail provider value.
